messages: anya: Quick thread on a slightly different take for the playground streaming UI. Proposals: (1) use "soft-stop" vs "hard-stop" wording to capture client-preserve vs server-abort, (2) token counter as a compact "token pebble" inside the composer that grows when active, (3) partial preserves show as an editable overlay draft (not immediately in composer) so users can choose to commit, (4) Prompt Shelf quick-insert shortcut: Ctrl+Space (configurable). Figma: https://figma.com/redwood/playground-token-pebble-proto ben: I like the pebble metaphor, feels lighter in the chrome. Quick microcopy ideas: - Soft Stop — keep partial (local draft) - Hard Stop — abort generation (free resources) - Pause — suspend stream (can resume) Keep icons small: pause (||), soft stop (broken-circle save), hard stop (square with X). maria: product constraints: soft-stop -> local overlay draft (not auto-sent), user must hit "Apply draft" to push it to the composer. Hard-stop -> server cancels and we still report tokens. Regenerate should run against the current visible draft if user hits regen from the overlay. Also include a tiny "revert to original partial" option. sam: backend notes: will implement generation.state = [streaming, soft-stopped, hard-stopped, completed]. Soft-stop should signal the server to stop streaming but keep the allocation until we confirm? That'd be expensive. Instead soft-stop = client stops reading stream and marks partial; server will treat as aborted but we tag `preserve_hint=client_softstop` so analytics know user wanted to keep. We'll emit `tokens_consumed` with `flag=soft_stop` or `hard_stop` accordingly. Also token pebble needs a final delta event. sam: caution: if soft-stop implies keeping server resources we'd need a new pricing model. Let's keep soft-stop client-only for now. linda: accessibility considerations: token pebble must be reachable and announced. Use `role=status` and `aria-live=polite`. For the overlay draft, announce: "Partial generation available as draft. Press Apply to edit, Escape to dismiss." Keyboard flows: Ctrl+Space opens Prompt Shelf, arrow keys navigate, Enter inserts into overlay/draft. Example snippet: ``` Tokens: 64 ``` linda: ensure the overlay is reachable by screen readers and focus traps into the overlay while editing. Provide a live region update on apply/dismiss. ben: UX nit: the pebble should show a subtle pulsing glow while streaming. On completion show a quick +N delta bubble above it for 2s then collapse. On mobile the pebble should expand to show a micro-count; otherwise stay icon-only. maria: agree on the mobile tweak. We'll add a small toggle in settings: "Compact token UI" default true. Also Prompt Shelf: add fuzzy search and categories. rachel: QA: test overlay drift on small screens (ensure it doesn't cover composer controls), and keyboard dismissal on macOS VoiceOver. Also test timing with slow streaming (partial arrives, user soft-stops immediately). sam: implementation plan: 1) emit final tokens event with `outcome` = [completed, soft_stop, hard_stop], 2) add `preserve_hint` for client-side saved partials, 3) wire delta metric to token-pebble. ETA spike: 2d. anya: decisions & action items: 1) use "Soft Stop/Hard Stop" microcopy across mocks (ben update Figma by EOD), 2) token pebble prototype + interaction states (ben add states), 3) maria draft the overlay draft flow + settings flag for compact UI (1d), 4) sam spike telemetry flags + final-token event (2d), 5) linda produce A11y checklist and example aria phrases (2d), 6) rachel add QA tickets for mobile/VO (3d). I'll set a 20m review Thurs 11am PT. ben: pushing frames now, will annotate the iconography for soft/hard stop. :sparkles: maria: I'll write the overlay copy and attach the decision doc. sam: starting spike tomorrow, will post notes here. linda: drafting aria text and keyboard table. rachel: creating QA matrix and device list. deploy-bot: Reminder: "Playground streaming mini-review" Thu 11:00 PT. Reply :+1: to RSVP. anya: thanks team — keeping thread open for any quick followups.
